proposed_widenings.name: container_storage_item
proposed_widenings.justification: Bag of Holding is primarily an inventory/container object with persistent capacity, interior-space rules, retrieval cost, breathable-air limits, and temporary unusable states. None of the existing magic-item families model stored contents or item access semantics honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet."

proposed_widenings.name: cross_item_extradimensional_collision
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's most dramatic mechanical consequence is a triggered cross-item interaction: placing it inside another extradimensional space destroys both items, creates a temporary gate, and exiles nearby creatures. That is neither a passive grant nor a user-activated ability under the current families.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_bag_of_holding.dhall. The current surface cannot honestly encode storage-capacity state, Utilize-based retrieval from contents, overload/pierce/inside-out destruction logic, air-supply tracking for creatures inside, or extradimensional-item collision triggers.
